title: Implement encrypted broadcast (B unified)
description: Mark decided 2026-10-16: broadcast posts encrypted under a channel content key; senderDID inside ciphertext; key served to members by the §3.4 Space endpoint (DID-auth for private Spaces); public channels publish the key in public Space state (one mechanism, policy choice). channelToken derived from content key, rotates on key rotation; subscriber removal = key rotation. State weaker-than-MLS properties (no FS within key period; removed subscriber keeps old keys). Removes 'relay CAN read' special case. Touches §5.2.1.4, §3.2 mode table, §3.4, ARCHITECTURE if needed.
